AXIOM_01_SOMATIC_VS_REFLEX.title: Somatic Orgasm vs. Spinal Ejaculatory Reflex
AXIOM_01_SOMATIC_VS_REFLEX.editorial_directive: Lead with the physiological distinction between a localized spinal motor reflex (ejaculation) and a comprehensive whole-body somatic orgasm. Cite the mobile glide sheath and specialized mechanoreceptors (Taylor, Cold, Sorrells). Explain lubricant dependency as an imposed cultural patch without shaming or condescension.

AXIOM_02_PROXY_CONSENT_PARADOX.title: The Limits of Proxy Consent and the Right to an Open Future
AXIOM_02_PROXY_CONSENT_PARADOX.editorial_directive: Frame parental proxy consent through standard biomedical ethics (Nuremberg, Helsinki, AMA Code). Reiterate that keeping a child intact requires zero medical justification—it is the biological baseline. The burden of proof rests entirely on the party proposing surgery on a healthy minor.

AXIOM_03_AESTHETIC_LOTTERY.title: The Surgical Lottery and Pathology Concealment
AXIOM_03_AESTHETIC_LOTTERY.editorial_directive: Explain that neonatal circumcision outcomes are highly variable and unpredictable due to rapid infant growth and imprecise clamping. Discuss common secondary complications like meatal stenosis and skin bridges objectively, highlighting that intact anatomy has natural uniformity and self-regulating mechanics.

AXIOM_04_INSTITUTIONAL_SHELL_GAME.title: Hospital Conveyor Belts and the Coding Migration
AXIOM_04_INSTITUTIONAL_SHELL_GAME.editorial_directive: Clarify that reported in-hospital rates (like Kids' Inpatient Database 49.3%) represent a floor, not the total rate. Expose how administrative billing codes and outpatient shifts sustain the procedure. Encourage expectant parents to establish proactive delivery-room refusal protocols.

AXIOM_05_TRANSPARENT_MONSTER.title: The Transparent Monster: Suspension of Clinical Risk Assessment
AXIOM_05_TRANSPARENT_MONSTER.editorial_directive: Use the 'Transparent Monster' concept to illustrate how deep cultural normalization causes intelligent, well-meaning clinicians and parents to abandon basic surgical risk assessment for this single procedure. Highlight the tragic disconnect between medical claims and infant vulnerability.

AXIOM_06_GASLIGHTING_AND_RESTORATION.title: Cultural Gaslighting, Adult Choice, and Tissue Expansion
AXIOM_06_GASLIGHTING_AND_RESTORATION.editorial_directive: Affirm adult bodily autonomy while deconstructing the cultural shame and aesthetic misinformation that leads men to consider circumcision. Validate foreskin restoration as evidence-based cellular tissue expansion that reverses glans keratinization and restores the essential glide mechanism.

AXIOM_07_INFERENCE_BY_QUALITY.title: Inference by Quality: The Curious Outsider Strategy
AXIOM_07_INFERENCE_BY_QUALITY.editorial_directive: Maintain the posture of the curious, compassionate observer. Never attack individuals, parents, or circumcised men. Present unarguable anatomy (Meissner corpuscles, glide mechanics) and international consensus so that the reader arrives at the realization of absurdity independently.

AXIOM_08_FEMININE_AND_CROSS_SEX_HOMOLOGY.title: Cross-Sex Homology and Shared Intimate Mechanics
AXIOM_08_FEMININE_AND_CROSS_SEX_HOMOLOGY.editorial_directive: Highlight the biological homology between male and female preputial anatomy. Emphasize that circumcision is not merely a male issue; it dramatically affects partner comfort, lubrication dynamics, and shared sexual pleasure. Cite O'Hara & O'Hara (1999) and preputial glide mechanics.

AXIOM_09_DISEASE_OF_THE_DECADE.title: The 150-Year Retcon: A Permanent Product Seeking Temporary Excuses
AXIOM_09_DISEASE_OF_THE_DECADE.editorial_directive: Deploy the 150-year Retcon timeline (/to/disease-of-the-decade). Demonstrate that circumcision was a surgical solution looking for a problem. Use the pharmaceutical pill analogy: a single intervention rebranded every fifteen years while always removing the exact same erogenous tissue.

AXIOM_10_BREAKING_THE_DEFLECTION_ARMOR.title: Deconstructing Locker-Room Deflection and Validating Grief
AXIOM_10_BREAKING_THE_DEFLECTION_ARMOR.editorial_directive: Approach circumcised men with unconditional empathy. Recognize that defensiveness and humor are normal coping mechanisms for non-consensual bodily alteration. Affirm that acknowledging what was lost is an act of courage, not deficiency, and that breaking the cycle protects the next generation.
